Author: Deuflhard
Description: ETK 854 ActiveHybrid 35d (N57) - a hypothetical six-cylinder diesel plug-in hybrid: 3.0 L inline-six diesel with two-stage sequential turbocharging (N57D30TOP calibration, 230 kW / 637 Nm, torque plateau 1500-2500 rpm, limiter 5400 rpm) + K0 disconnect clutch + 83 kW / 265 Nm P2 e-machine ahead of the torque converter, 8-speed automatic, 2.81 rear axle ratio, rear-wheel drive. 13.5 kWh battery, 50 L diesel tank. System output 313 kW (426 PS); the VCU caps the combined input torque at 680 Nm, the same cap as on the 40e, for a realistic power delivery. Sequential-turbo character: full boost from about 1200 rpm, around 0.33 s response time. Sailing, recuperation and all-electric pull-away. Delivered without the factory 250 km/h top-speed limiter (top speed limited by the powertrain).
